description:
Reid Let's Roll 350W eBike | Commuter Bike [AU]
Comfortable, practical and designed for everyday journeys – the Reid Let's Roll Commuter eBike is a step-through electric commuter bike built for relaxed city riding, daily commuting and exploring light trails with ease.
The Reid Let's Roll combines stylish design with dependable electric assistance, making it an ideal choice for riders looking for a comfortable and convenient way to get around. Its lightweight 6061 alloy frame features internal cable routing and an integrated 36V 10.4Ah 374Wh battery for a clean, streamlined finish. The step-through frame makes getting on and off the bike easy, adding convenience to everyday cycling.
A 350W Jiabo rear hub motor delivers smooth, consistent electric assistance, helping you tackle hills and cover longer distances with less effort. The Key Display KD58 handlebar-mounted display keeps essential ride information clearly visible while you're on the move. An L-TWOO 7-speed trigger shifter paired with a Shimano rear derailleur provides reliable gearing options for navigating city streets, cycle paths and gentle inclines.
Designed for comfort and control, the Let's Roll features wide 27.5 x 2.1-inch commuter tyres that provide added cushioning and stability across uneven roads and light trails. Tektro hydraulic disc brakes deliver responsive, controlled stopping power in varying riding conditions, helping you ride with confidence around town and on everyday journeys.
Every detail is designed to support a relaxed, comfortable ride. The 640mm swept-back alloy riser handlebar encourages an upright riding position, while comfortable rubber grips and a plush city comfort saddle help make daily commutes and longer rides more enjoyable. An alloy ahead stem completes the practical setup, creating an electric commuter bike suited to regular use.
Whether you're commuting to work, running errands around town or enjoying a leisurely weekend ride, the Reid Let's Roll Commuter eBike makes everyday cycling more comfortable and convenient. With its 350W Jiabo rear hub motor, integrated battery, step-through frame and comfort-focused components, it's a versatile choice for riders looking to travel efficiently and enjoy more time on two wheels.
The Reid Let's Roll Commuter eBike is ideal for:

Everyday commuters looking for a comfortable electric commuter bike for travelling to work and getting around town

Riders who prefer easy access, with a step-through frame that makes mounting and dismounting straightforward

Comfort-focused cyclists, with an upright riding position, swept-back handlebars, comfortable rubber grips and a plush city comfort saddle

Riders tackling hills and longer journeys, with a 350W Jiabo rear hub motor providing electric assistance

City and urban riding, with wide 27.5 x 2.1-inch commuter tyres for added stability and cushioning on roads and cycle paths

Cyclists exploring light trails, with a versatile design suited to a variety of everyday riding surfaces

Riders seeking reliable braking performance, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes for controlled stopping power

Cyclists who value clear ride information, with a Key Display KD58 handlebar-mounted display

Anyone looking for a practical alternative to driving, making everyday journeys more active, convenient and enjoyable

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike and eScooter safety information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.

components.description: Tektro HD-M275 hydraulic disc brakes, 160mm rotors
Downtube integrated 36V 10.4 Ah 374Wh Lithium-Ion Battery IEC62133 certified
Jiabo 90T 36V 250W (350W peak power) rear hub motor 42Nm torque
Key Display KD58 display with 5 modes of assist
Alloy riser bar 640mm wide, 40mm rise, 31.8mm clamp
Alloy nutted front, rear hub motor
Alloy A head stem, 60mm length, 31.8mm clamp
